name: Can I replace my roof in the winter, or is it better to wait for warmer weather?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my roof in the winter, or is it better to wait for warmer weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roof replacement is possible during winter months in Southern California, as our weather is generally mild. However, extremely cold temperatures, heavy rain, or strong winds can sometimes delay projects for safety and optimal material installation. While warmer, drier seasons are often preferred for efficiency, we can typically schedule and complete roofing projects year-round, weather permitting. We will assess conditions and advise the best approach for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Roof replacement is possible year-round in Southern California, though extreme weather can cause delays. We assess conditions for optimal timing.
